dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acute ischemic infarction of the left rostral pons and caudal midbrain caused by top-of-the-basilar artery occlusion, producing a brainstem ocular tilt reaction and ipsilateral ataxia.

ALTERNATIVE 1: Basilar artery thromboembolism from an undetermined cardiac or arterial source.

ALTERNATIVE 2: Vertebrobasilar atherosclerotic thrombosis.

ALTERNATIVE 3: Basilar artery dissection with thrombotic occlusion.
